facts.fact: INE cites the accessibility principle of Lei n.º 3/11 of 14 January, Lei do Sistema Estatístico Nacional, as the basis for publishing the 2024 census results and 10% of microdata, treating it as the current law (release dated 20 November 2025).
facts.system: Lei n.º 3/11, Lei do Sistema Estatístico Nacional (2011)
